objective.text: Clear channel context deliberately so unrelated later log entries do not retain it.

difficulty.rationale: Prevent one unit of work’s metadata from contaminating later entries on the same logger.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: This is one Illuminate Log Logger instance. It has channel context from withContext, not global Context-facade data.

stem: After finishing tenant-specific work, the same logger will serve unrelated work. Which operation removes the channel context before those later entries?

options.rationale: Merging an empty context leaves existing keys unchanged.
options.misconception: Merging an empty context leaves existing keys unchanged.

options.rationale: An empty entry context does not erase the logger’s stored context.
options.misconception: An empty entry context does not erase the logger’s stored context.

options.rationale: The method clears that logger’s stored channel context.
This overrides tenant only on that entry and does not clear other stored keys or future entries.
options.misconception: This overrides tenant only on that entry and does not clear other stored keys or future entries.
